[echo] Echo a message back.

printf '{"echo":"%s","task":"%s"}' "$TASK_MESSAGE" "$TASK"
---
[token-kind] The kind of upstream token the task was handed (its prefix, never the token).

printf '{"token_kind":"%s"}' "${TASK_TOKEN%%-*}"
---
[fail] Fail on purpose.

echo "it broke: $TASK_REASON" >&2
exit 3
